[2026 Newcastle lord mayoral by-election - Wikipedia] A by-election was held on 18 April 2026 to elect the lord mayor of the City of Newcastle. The vacancy was triggered by the resignation of Lord Mayor Ross Kerridge to focus on his health. Independent candidate Gavin Morris was elected in a landslide with over 67% of the two-candidate preferred vote.
[Gavin Morris (politician) - Wikipedia] Gavin Scott Morris[2] is an Australian news presenter and politician who is serving as the Lord Mayor of Newcastle since a by-election in April 2026. Prior to his election to civic office, Morris was a news reader and weatherman for NBN Television as well as a presenter on Today for the Nine Network. [3][4]
[2026 Newcastle lord mayoral by-election - Wikiwand] A by-election was held on 18 April 2026 to elect the lord mayor of Newcastle. The vacancy was triggered by the resignation of Lord Mayor Dr Ross Kerridge to focus on his health. Nominations for the by-election closed on Wednesday, 18 March 2026. Independent candidate Gavin Morris was elected with over 51% of the first preference vote.
